reason_for_correction: The HKMA RMB reference is a Hong Kong end-of-day observation in the same Asian trading day as A shares. Reusing the U.S.-market cumulative-minus-last-daily transform would contaminate the intended unabsorbed closure signal with part of the previous China trading day's already-observable Asian price move.

financial_clock.start_level: latest observed HKMA USD/CNY_HK cross on or before the previous China trading date; this end-of-day level is treated as the conservative post-China-close boundary
financial_clock.end_level: latest observed HKMA USD/CNY_HK cross with observation date strictly before the target China trading date
financial_clock.zero_rule: if end observation date is not later than the start observation date, closure_return = 0
financial_clock.no_last_daily_subtraction: There is no HKMA daily-return term in the v3 comparator. The entire post-boundary HKMA closure return is new China-FX information; subtracting the final HKMA daily return would discard valid unabsorbed information without a baseline-duplication reason.

scope: This correction changes only the source-specific causal measurement. The v4 economic question, frozen Ridge model, 2015-2018 train period, 2019-2020 consumed holdout, no-PnL selection rule and no-production authority remain unchanged.

adjudication.progression_rule: candidate must improve full-holdout IC, lower full-holdout SSE, and improve SSE on rows where at least one later HKMA end-of-day observation accumulated after the previous China date; holiday-reopen diagnostics must also be reported
adjudication.expected_sign: positive USD/CNY_HK closure return means RMB depreciation; a negative model coefficient is economically expected but is diagnostic rather than a selection gate

forbidden: using an HKMA observation after the target China date
labeling the HKMA derived cross as exact executable interbank CNH
